case_number.intent: Records the unique administrative identifier for the case. Evidence is provided by the worker or administrative records.

client_first_name.intent: Records the client's legal first name. Evidence is provided by the client or their legal documentation.

client_last_name.intent: Records the client's legal last name. Evidence is provided by the client or their legal documentation.

client_preferred_name.intent: Records the name the client uses in social or daily contexts. Evidence is provided by the client.

client_dob.intent: Records the client's legal date of birth. Evidence is provided by the client or legal documentation.

pronouns.intent: Records the pronouns the client uses for themselves. Do not infer pronouns from the client's gender identity or appearance.

option_semantics.SHE_HER: The client explicitly states they use she/her pronouns.
option_semantics.HE_HIM: The client explicitly states they use he/him pronouns.
option_semantics.THEY_THEM: The client explicitly states they use they/them pronouns.
option_semantics.OTHER: The client specifies pronouns other than the standard options provided.

gender_identity.intent: Records how the client identifies their gender. Do not infer gender identity from pronouns or appearance.

option_semantics.WOMAN: The client identifies as a woman.
option_semantics.MAN: The client identifies as a man.
option_semantics.TRANSGENDER_WOMAN: The client identifies as a transgender woman.
option_semantics.TRANSGENDER_MAN: The client identifies as a transgender man.
option_semantics.OTHER: The client identifies with a gender identity not listed.
option_semantics.DECLINED: The client explicitly states they do not wish to disclose their gender identity.

contact_phone.intent: Records the client's primary telephone number. Evidence is provided by the client.

contact_email.intent: Records the client's primary email address. Evidence is provided by the client.

contact_ok_voicemail.intent: Records the client's consent regarding leaving messages on their phone. Evidence is provided by the client.

option_semantics.YES: The client gives permission to leave a voicemail.
option_semantics.NO: The client explicitly states they do not want a voicemail left.

address_line.intent: Records the client's street address. Evidence is provided by the client.

address_city.intent: Records the city of the client's residence. Evidence is provided by the client.

address_zip.intent: Records the ZIP code of the client's residence. Evidence is provided by the client.

language_combo.intent: Records the client's preferred language for communication. Evidence is provided by the client.

option_semantics.ENGLISH: The client states English is their preferred language.
option_semantics.SPANISH: The client states Spanish is their preferred language.
option_semantics.VIETNAMESE: The client states Vietnamese is their preferred language.
option_semantics.TAGALOG: The client states Tagalog is their preferred language.
option_semantics.MANDARIN: The client states Mandarin is their preferred language.
option_semantics.ARABIC: The client states Arabic is their preferred language.
option_semantics.OTHER: The client specifies a preferred language other than those listed.

interpreter_needed.intent: Records whether the client requires an interpreter for communication. Evidence is provided by the client or the worker's observation of a language barrier.

option_semantics.YES: The client or worker indicates an interpreter is required.
option_semantics.NO: The client or worker indicates an interpreter is not required.

session_date.intent: Records the date the session occurred.

session_type.intent: Records the classification of the session encounter.

option_semantics.INTAKE: The session is an initial assessment or intake.
option_semantics.FOLLOW_UP: The session is a scheduled follow-up to previous treatment.
option_semantics.CRISIS: The session is an unscheduled or urgent crisis intervention.

session_modality.intent: Records the medium through which the service was delivered.

option_semantics.VIDEO: The session was conducted via video conferencing.
option_semantics.PHONE: The session was conducted via telephone.
option_semantics.IN_PERSON: The session was conducted in person at a physical location.

f_f79934c38a.intent: Records the total length of the session in minutes.

referral_source.intent: Records the entity or person that initiated the client's entry into services.

option_semantics.SELF: The client sought services on their own without a referral.
option_semantics.SCHOOL: The referral came from an educational institution.
option_semantics.PCP: The referral came from a primary care physician.
option_semantics.HOSPITAL: The referral came from a hospital or medical facility.
option_semantics.CPS: The referral came from Child Protective Services.
option_semantics.COURT: The referral came from a court or legal system.
option_semantics.COMMUNITY_ORG: The referral came from a community-based organization.
option_semantics.OTHER: The referral came from a source not listed above.

consent_telehealth.intent: Records the method by which the client consented to telehealth services.

option_semantics.VERBAL: The client provided verbal consent for telehealth.
option_semantics.WRITTEN: The client provided written consent for telehealth.
option_semantics.DECLINED: The client refused to consent to telehealth.

insurance_type.intent: Records the type of health insurance coverage the client has.

option_semantics.PRIVATE: The client has private commercial insurance.
option_semantics.UNINSURED: The client has no health insurance.
option_semantics.UNKNOWN: The client's insurance status is unknown.

insurance_member_id.intent: Records the specific identification number for the client's insurance policy.

emergency_contact_name.intent: Records the full name of the client's designated emergency contact.

emergency_contact_phone.intent: Records the telephone number for the client's designated emergency contact.

emergency_contact_relationship.intent: Records the relationship of the emergency contact to the client.

option_semantics.PARENT: The contact is the client's parent.
option_semantics.SIBLING: The contact is the client's sibling.
option_semantics.PARTNER: The contact is the client's partner.
option_semantics.CHILD: The contact is the client's child.
option_semantics.FRIEND: The contact is a friend of the client.
option_semantics.OTHER: The contact has a relationship other than those listed.

release_of_info.intent: Records which entities the client has signed releases for.

option_semantics.PCP: A release is on file for the Primary Care Provider.
option_semantics.PSYCHIATRIST: A release is on file for a Psychiatrist.
option_semantics.SCHOOL: A release is on file for the client's school.
option_semantics.FAMILY: A release is on file for family members.

phq9_1.intent: Records the client's response to the PHQ-9 item regarding anhedonia.

option_semantics.0: The client reports not at all.
option_semantics.2: The client reports more than half the days.
option_semantics.3: The client reports nearly every day.

phq9_2.intent: Records the client's response to the PHQ-9 item regarding depressed mood.

option_semantics.0: The client reports not at all.
option_semantics.2: The client reports more than half the days.
option_semantics.3: The client reports nearly every day.

phq9_3.intent: Records the client's response to the PHQ-9 item regarding sleep disturbance.

option_semantics.0: The client reports not at all.
option_semantics.2: The client reports more than half the days.
option_semantics.3: The client reports nearly every day.

phq9_4.intent: Records the frequency of feeling tired or having little energy based on the client's self-report.

option_semantics.0: Client states they do not feel tired or lack energy at all.
option_semantics.1: Client states they feel tired or lack energy for several days.
option_semantics.2: Client states they feel tired or lack energy for more than half the days.
option_semantics.3: Client states they feel tired or lack energy nearly every day.

phq9_5.intent: Records the frequency of changes in appetite or overeating based on the client's self-report.

option_semantics.0: Client states they have no issues with appetite or overeating.
option_semantics.1: Client states they have appetite or overeating issues for several days.
option_semantics.2: Client states they have appetite or overeating issues for more than half the days.
option_semantics.3: Client states they have appetite or overeating issues nearly every day.

phq9_6.intent: Records the frequency of feelings of failure or self-disappointment based on the client's self-report.

option_semantics.0: Client states they do not feel like a failure or that they have let people down.
option_semantics.1: Client states they feel like a failure or have let people down for several days.
option_semantics.2: Client states they feel like a failure or have let people down for more than half the days.
option_semantics.3: Client states they feel like a failure or have let people down nearly every day.

phq9_7.intent: Records the frequency of difficulty concentrating based on the client's self-report.

option_semantics.0: Client states they have no trouble concentrating.
option_semantics.1: Client states they have trouble concentrating for several days.
option_semantics.2: Client states they have trouble concentrating for more than half the days.
option_semantics.3: Client states they have trouble concentrating nearly every day.

phq9_8.intent: Records the frequency of psychomotor changes (slowing down or restlessness) as perceived by others, based on the client's self-report.

option_semantics.0: Client states others have not noticed changes in their movement or speech.
option_semantics.1: Client states others have noticed changes in movement or speech for several days.
option_semantics.2: Client states others have noticed changes in movement or speech for more than half the days.
option_semantics.3: Client states others have noticed changes in movement or speech nearly every day.

phq9_9.intent: Records the frequency of thoughts of self-harm or death based on the client's self-report.

option_semantics.0: Client states they have no thoughts of death or hurting themselves.
option_semantics.1: Client states they have had thoughts of death or hurting themselves for several days.
option_semantics.2: Client states they have had thoughts of death or hurting themselves for more than half the days.
option_semantics.3: Client states they have had thoughts of death or hurting themselves nearly every day.

phq9_score.intent: PHQ-9 total, computed in code from the 9 items.

phq9_severity.intent: PHQ-9 severity band, computed in code from the 9 items.

phq9_difficulty.intent: Records the level of functional impairment caused by the symptoms mentioned in the PHQ-9.

option_semantics.NOT_DIFFICULT: Client states the problems are not difficult at all to manage.
option_semantics.SOMEWHAT: Client states the problems are somewhat difficult to manage.
option_semantics.VERY: Client states the problems are very difficult to manage.
option_semantics.EXTREMELY: Client states the problems are extremely difficult to manage.

gad7_status.intent: Records whether the GAD-7 assessment was administered, deferred, declined, or not indicated during the session.

option_semantics.COMPLETED: The worker or client confirms the GAD-7 was completed.
option_semantics.DEFERRED: The worker notes the GAD-7 was postponed to a later time.
option_semantics.DECLINED: The client explicitly refuses to complete the GAD-7.
option_semantics.NOT_INDICATED: The worker determines the GAD-7 is not necessary for this session.

gad7_1.intent: Records the frequency of feeling nervous, anxious, or on edge based on the client's self-report.

option_semantics.0: Client states they do not feel nervous, anxious, or on edge at all.
option_semantics.1: Client states they feel nervous, anxious, or on edge for several days.
option_semantics.2: Client states they feel nervous, anxious, or on edge for more than half the days.
option_semantics.3: Client states they feel nervous, anxious, or on edge nearly every day.

gad7_2.intent: Records the frequency of inability to control worrying based on the client's self-report.

option_semantics.0: Client states they have no trouble controlling worry.
option_semantics.1: Client states they have trouble controlling worry for several days.
option_semantics.2: Client states they have trouble controlling worry for more than half the days.
option_semantics.3: Client states they have trouble controlling worry nearly every day.

gad7_3.intent: Records the frequency of excessive worrying about various topics based on the client's self-report.

option_semantics.0: Client states they do not worry too much about different things.
option_semantics.1: Client states they worry too much about different things for several days.
option_semantics.2: Client states they worry too much about different things for more than half the days.
option_semantics.3: Client states they worry too much about different things nearly every day.

gad7_4.intent: Records the frequency of difficulty relaxing based on the client's self-report.

option_semantics.0: Client states they have no trouble relaxing.
option_semantics.1: Client states they have trouble relaxing for several days.
option_semantics.2: Client states they have trouble relaxing for more than half the days.
option_semantics.3: Client states they have trouble relaxing nearly every day.

gad7_5.intent: Records the frequency of restlessness based on the client's self-report.

option_semantics.0: Client states they do not feel restless or unable to sit still.
option_semantics.1: Client states they feel restless for several days.
option_semantics.2: Client states they feel restless for more than half the days.
option_semantics.3: Client states they feel restless nearly every day.

gad7_6.intent: Records the frequency of irritability based on the client's self-report.

option_semantics.0: Client states they do not become easily annoyed or irritable.
option_semantics.1: Client states they become easily annoyed or irritable for several days.
option_semantics.2: Client states they become easily annoyed or irritable for more than half the days.
option_semantics.3: Client states they become easily annoyed or irritable nearly every day.

gad7_7.intent: Records the frequency of feeling fearful or afraid of catastrophe based on the client's self-report.

option_semantics.0: Client states they do not feel afraid as if something awful might happen.
option_semantics.1: Client states they feel afraid as if something awful might happen for several days.
option_semantics.2: Client states they feel afraid as if something awful might happen for more than half the days.
option_semantics.3: Client states they feel afraid as if something awful might happen nearly every day.

gad7_score.intent: GAD-7 total, computed in code from the 7 items.

gad7_severity.intent: GAD-7 severity band, computed in code from the 7 items.

si_ideation.intent: Records the presence and type of suicidal ideation expressed by the client. Do not infer ideation from general expressions of hopelessness or sadness.

option_semantics.NONE: Client states they have no thoughts of suicide.
option_semantics.PASSIVE: Client expresses thoughts of wanting to die or wishing they wouldn't wake up, but has no intent to act.
option_semantics.ACTIVE_NO_PLAN: Client expresses active thoughts of killing themselves but has not formulated a specific method or plan.
option_semantics.ACTIVE_WITH_PLAN: Client expresses active thoughts of killing themselves and has a specific method or plan in mind.

si_frequency.intent: Records how often the client has experienced suicidal ideation over the past two weeks. Based on client's self-report of frequency.

option_semantics.NONE: Client states they have had no suicidal ideation in the last two weeks.
option_semantics.SEVERAL_DAYS: Client states ideation occurred on several days in the last two weeks.
option_semantics.MORE_THAN_HALF: Client states ideation occurred on more than half the days in the last two weeks.
option_semantics.NEARLY_EVERY_DAY: Client states ideation occurred almost every day in the last two weeks.

si_plan.intent: Records whether the client has a specific plan for suicide. Based on client's description of their thoughts.

option_semantics.NO: Client explicitly states they have no plan.
option_semantics.YES: Client describes a specific method or way they intend to end their life.

si_intent.intent: Records the client's level of intent to act on suicidal thoughts. Based on client's stated desire or lack thereof to act.

option_semantics.NO: Client states they have no intention of acting on their thoughts.
option_semantics.YES: Client states they intend to act on their suicidal thoughts.

si_means.intent: Records the client's access to lethal means for suicide. Based on client's report of their environment or belongings.

option_semantics.NO_ACCESS: Client states they do not have access to lethal means.
option_semantics.HAS_ACCESS: Client states they have access to lethal means (e.g., firearms, medications, etc.).

si_prior_attempts.intent: Records the client's history of suicide attempts. Based on client's self-reported history.

option_semantics.NONE: Client states they have never attempted suicide.
option_semantics.ONE: Client states they have had one prior suicide attempt.
option_semantics.MULTIPLE: Client states they have had more than one prior suicide attempt.

hi_ideation.intent: Records the presence and type of homicidal ideation expressed by the client. Do not infer homicidal intent from anger or frustration.

option_semantics.NONE: Client states they have no thoughts of harming others.
option_semantics.PASSIVE: Client expresses thoughts of wanting to harm others but has no specific plan or intent.
option_semantics.ACTIVE: Client expresses active thoughts of harming a specific person or people.

hi_plan.intent: Records whether the client has a specific plan for homicide. Based on client's description of their thoughts.

option_semantics.NO: Client states they have no plan to harm others.
option_semantics.YES: Client describes a specific method or way they intend to harm others.

safety_plan.intent: Records the status of the safety planning process during the session. Based on worker's actions and client's participation.

option_semantics.COMPLETED: A new safety plan was fully developed and finalized during the session.
option_semantics.UPDATED: An existing safety plan was modified or updated during the session.
option_semantics.REVIEWED: An existing safety plan was reviewed for effectiveness during the session.
option_semantics.DEFERRED: The worker decided to postpone safety planning to a later time.
option_semantics.DECLINED: The client refused to participate in safety planning.

risk_narrative.intent: A summary of the clinical reasoning and evidence regarding the client's risk of harm to self or others. Written by the clinician.

risk_level.intent: The clinician's professional determination of the client's overall risk level. This is a clinical judgment.

supervisor_consult.intent: Records whether the clinician consulted with a supervisor regarding the client's case or risk. Based on worker's actions.

option_semantics.YES: Clinician states they consulted with a supervisor.
option_semantics.NO: Clinician states they did not consult with a supervisor.
option_semantics.PLANNED: Clinician states they intend to consult with a supervisor.

protective_factors.intent: Records factors identified by the client that motivate them to remain safe or stay connected to life. Based on client's statements.

option_semantics.FAMILY_CONNECTION: Client mentions family as a reason to stay safe.
option_semantics.CHILDREN_IN_HOME: Client mentions their children as a reason to stay safe.
option_semantics.FUTURE_ORIENTATION: Client expresses goals or reasons to look toward the future.
option_semantics.RELIGIOUS_BELIEFS: Client mentions faith or religious community as a reason to stay safe.
option_semantics.TREATMENT_ENGAGEMENT: Client expresses commitment to the therapeutic process.
option_semantics.PETS: Client mentions pets as a reason to stay safe.

crisis_resources.intent: Records which specific crisis resources the worker provided to the client during the session. Based on worker's actions.

option_semantics.LINE_988: Worker provided information for the 988 Lifeline.
option_semantics.COUNTY_CRISIS: Worker provided information for the local county crisis line.
option_semantics.MOBILE_CRISIS: Worker provided information for a mobile crisis team.
option_semantics.WARMLINE: Worker provided information for a warmline.

presenting_problem.intent: A narrative summary of the reasons the client is seeking services. Based on the client's description of their concerns.

psychosocial_history.intent: Records the client's background, life events, and social circumstances as described by the client.

interventions.intent: Summarizes the specific therapeutic or case management actions taken by the worker during the session.

plan.intent: Outlines the agreed-upon next steps for the client and the worker following the session.

client_strengths.intent: Summarizes the internal assets, skills, or external supports identified by the client or observed by the worker.

housing_status.intent: Records the client's current stability and type of housing situation.

option_semantics.STABLE: Client states they have permanent, secure housing.
option_semantics.AT_RISK: Client expresses concern about losing housing or facing eviction.
option_semantics.DOUBLED_UP: Client is staying with others temporarily due to lack of space.
option_semantics.SHELTERED: Client is currently staying in a formal shelter system.
option_semantics.UNSHELTERED: Client is experiencing homelessness (e.g., street, car, park).

living_situation.intent: Records the specific household composition or people the client resides with.

option_semantics.ALONE: Client states they live by themselves.
option_semantics.WITH_FAMILY: Client states they live with relatives.
option_semantics.WITH_PARTNER: Client states they live with a significant other.
option_semantics.ROOMMATES: Client states they live with non-family roommates.
option_semantics.OTHER: Client states they live with people not covered by other categories.

employment_status.intent: Records the client's current work or labor force status.

option_semantics.EMPLOYED_FT: Client states they work full-time hours.
option_semantics.EMPLOYED_PT: Client states they work part-time hours.
option_semantics.UNEMPLOYED: Client states they are currently without a job.
option_semantics.NOT_IN_LABOR_FORCE: Client states they are not looking for work (e.g., retired, homemaker).
option_semantics.DISABLED: Client states they are unable to work due to a disability.
option_semantics.STUDENT: Client states they are currently enrolled in school.

food_security.intent: Records whether the client has consistent access to adequate food.

option_semantics.SECURE: Client states they have reliable access to food.
option_semantics.INSECURE: Client states they struggle to afford or access food.

income_sources.intent: Records the specific ways the client receives financial support.

option_semantics.WAGES: Client reports earning money from employment.
option_semantics.SNAP: Client reports receiving SNAP or CalFresh.
option_semantics.TANF: Client reports receiving TANF or CalWORKs.
option_semantics.NONE: Client reports having no income sources.

transportation.intent: Records the client's ability to access transportation for appointments or work.

option_semantics.RELIABLE: Client states they have consistent, dependable transportation.
option_semantics.UNRELIABLE: Client states transportation is inconsistent or difficult to secure.
option_semantics.NONE: Client states they have no means of transportation.

legal_involvement.intent: Records any current involvement with the legal or child welfare systems.

option_semantics.NONE: Client states they have no legal involvement.
option_semantics.PROBATION: Client states they are on probation.
option_semantics.PENDING_CASE: Client states they have an active or pending legal case.
option_semantics.FAMILY_COURT: Client states they are involved in family court proceedings.
option_semantics.CPS_OPEN: Client states they have an open CPS case.

children_in_home.intent: Records whether minor children reside in the client's household.

option_semantics.YES: Client states there are minor children living in the home.
option_semantics.NO: Client states there are no minor children living in the home.

substances.intent: Records substances used by the client within the last 30 days.

option_semantics.NONE_REPORTED: Client reports no substance use in the last 30 days.

alcohol_frequency.intent: Records how often the client consumes alcohol.

option_semantics.NEVER: Client states they never consume alcohol.
option_semantics.MONTHLY_OR_LESS: Client states they consume alcohol once a month or less.
option_semantics.TWO_TO_FOUR_PER_MONTH: Client states they consume alcohol 2–4 times per month.
option_semantics.TWO_TO_THREE_PER_WEEK: Client states they consume alcohol 2–3 times per week.
option_semantics.FOUR_PLUS_PER_WEEK: Client states they consume alcohol 4 or more times per week.

tobacco_use.intent: Records the client's history of tobacco or nicotine use.

option_semantics.NEVER: Client states they have never used tobacco/nicotine.
option_semantics.FORMER: Client states they used to use tobacco/nicotine but have quit.
option_semantics.CURRENT: Client states they currently use tobacco/nicotine.

substance_tx_history.intent: Records the client's history of receiving treatment for substance use. Evidence comes from the client's self-report of past treatment settings.

option_semantics.NONE: Client states they have never received treatment for substance use.
option_semantics.OUTPATIENT: Client states they have attended outpatient treatment programs.
option_semantics.RESIDENTIAL: Client states they have attended residential/inpatient treatment programs.
option_semantics.MAT: Client states they have participated in Medication-Assisted Treatment.

pcp_name.intent: Records the name of the client's primary care physician. Evidence comes from the client's report of their medical provider.

medication_adherence.intent: Records how consistently the client takes prescribed medications. Evidence comes from the client's report of their medication habits.

option_semantics.ADHERENT: Client states they take all medications exactly as prescribed.
option_semantics.PARTIAL: Client states they sometimes miss doses or take medications inconsistently.
option_semantics.NOT_TAKING: Client states they are not taking their prescribed medications at all.
option_semantics.NONE_PRESCRIBED: Leave blank if the client states they are not currently prescribed any medications.

current_medications.intent: Records a list of medications the client is currently taking. Evidence comes from the client's report of their medication regimen.

medical_conditions.intent: Records the client's known medical diagnoses or health conditions. Evidence comes from the client's report of their medical history.

sleep_hours.intent: Records the typical number of hours the client sleeps per night. Evidence comes from the client's report of their sleep patterns.

support_system.intent: Records the types of social supports the client identifies as having. Evidence comes from the client's report of their social network.

option_semantics.FAMILY: Client identifies family members as part of their support system.
option_semantics.FRIENDS: Client identifies friends as part of their support system.
option_semantics.FAITH_COMMUNITY: Client identifies a religious or spiritual community as part of their support system.
option_semantics.PEER_GROUP: Client identifies a peer group (e.g., recovery groups) as part of their support system.
option_semantics.NONE: Leave blank if the client states they have no social supports.

mse_appearance.intent: Records the clinician's observation of the client's physical presentation. This is a professional observation.

mse_mood.intent: Records the client's subjective report of their emotional state. Evidence must be the client's own words.

mse_affect.intent: Records the clinician's observation of the client's expressed emotion. This is a professional observation.

mse_thought_process.intent: Records the clinician's observation of the organization and flow of the client's thoughts. This is a professional observation.

mse_orientation.intent: Records the clinician's assessment of the client's awareness of person, place, time, and situation. This is a professional observation.

mse_insight.intent: Records the clinician's assessment of the client's understanding of their situation or illness. This is a professional observation.

mse_judgment.intent: Records the clinician's assessment of the client's ability to make sound decisions. This is a professional observation.

adl_bathing.intent: Records the clinician's assessment of the client's ability to perform bathing tasks. This is a professional observation.

adl_dressing.intent: Records the client's ability to dress themselves. Evidence comes from the client's description of daily self-care tasks or the worker's observation of physical limitations.

option_semantics.INDEPENDENT: The client states they can dress themselves without help.
option_semantics.NEEDS_ASSISTANCE: The client states they require some help or tools to dress themselves.
option_semantics.DEPENDENT: The client states they are unable to dress themselves and rely entirely on others.

adl_eating.intent: Records the client's ability to feed themselves. Evidence comes from the client's description of mealtime capabilities or physical limitations.

option_semantics.INDEPENDENT: The client states they can feed themselves without help.
option_semantics.NEEDS_ASSISTANCE: The client states they require some help or adaptive equipment to eat.
option_semantics.DEPENDENT: The client states they are unable to feed themselves and rely entirely on others.

adl_mobility.intent: Records the client's ability to move around. Evidence comes from the client's description of walking, transferring, or using mobility aids.

option_semantics.INDEPENDENT: The client states they can move around their environment without help.
option_semantics.NEEDS_ASSISTANCE: The client states they require some help or mobility aids to move.
option_semantics.DEPENDENT: The client states they are unable to move themselves and rely entirely on others.

iadl_finances.intent: Records the client's ability to manage their money. Evidence comes from the client's description of paying bills or managing income.

option_semantics.INDEPENDENT: The client states they manage their own finances without help.
option_semantics.NEEDS_ASSISTANCE: The client states they require some help with money management or bill paying.
option_semantics.DEPENDENT: The client states they are unable to manage their finances and rely entirely on others.

iadl_transport.intent: Records the client's ability to use transportation. Evidence comes from the client's description of getting to appointments or navigating transit.

option_semantics.INDEPENDENT: The client states they can use transportation independently.
option_semantics.NEEDS_ASSISTANCE: The client states they require some help or assistance to use transportation.
option_semantics.DEPENDENT: The client states they are unable to use transportation and rely entirely on others.

iadl_medications.intent: Records the client's ability to manage their medications. Evidence comes from the client's description of taking their prescribed medicine.

option_semantics.INDEPENDENT: The client states they manage their own medication regimen without help.
option_semantics.NEEDS_ASSISTANCE: The client states they require some help or reminders to take medications.
option_semantics.DEPENDENT: The client states they are unable to manage their medications and rely entirely on others.

referrals_made.intent: Records which specific resources or services the worker has referred the client to. Evidence comes from the worker's statements regarding referrals provided during the session.

option_semantics.FOOD_BANK: The worker states a referral to a food bank was made.
option_semantics.HOUSING_NAV: The worker states a referral to housing navigation was made.
option_semantics.BENEFITS: The worker states a referral for benefits enrollment was made.
option_semantics.PSYCHIATRY: The worker states a referral to psychiatry was made.
option_semantics.SUBSTANCE_TX: The worker states a referral to substance-use treatment was made.
option_semantics.LEGAL_AID: The worker states a referral to legal aid was made.
option_semantics.NONE: The worker states no referrals were made.

client_goal.intent: Records the client's stated goals for treatment or life. Evidence comes from the client's own words.

next_appointment.intent: Records the scheduled date for the next session. Evidence comes from the worker's statements regarding the schedule.

follow_up_interval.intent: Records the agreed-upon frequency of future sessions. Evidence comes from the worker's statements regarding the follow-up plan.

option_semantics.WEEKLY: The worker states the client will be seen weekly.
option_semantics.BIWEEKLY: The worker states the client will be seen every 2 weeks.
option_semantics.MONTHLY: The worker states the client will be seen monthly.
option_semantics.AS_NEEDED: The worker states the client will be seen on an as-needed basis.

level_of_care.intent: Records the clinician's professional recommendation for the intensity of services required. This is a professional judgment.

diagnosis_impression.intent: Records the clinician's professional diagnostic assessment. This is a professional judgment.

note_attestation.intent: Records the clinician's formal attestation that the note is an accurate reflection of services provided.

option_semantics.ATTESTED: The clinician checks the box to attest to the note.
